native-commands.title: Native commands
native-commands.disclosure: Runs with full access on this session’s Runner, outside the thread sandbox.
native-commands.idleOnly: Commands are available after the original Codex session is idle and cleanup is confirmed.
native-commands.unsupported: The original Runner does not have a supported native command profile.
native-commands.timeoutHelp: Default: 1 hour. 0 stops immediately. Maximum: 1 hour.
native-commands.invalidTimeout: Enter a whole number from 0 to 3600.
native-commands.uncertain: The original action is uncertain. Read its status; the command will not be resent.
